{{Quote|We have a proud and rich history, with many archaeological monuments and treasures from Duro's Golden Age. Nearly every schoolchild on every civilized planet learns about our ancient history&mdash;that glorious time when my people were ruled by the great Queen Rana, our wise lawgiver.|[[Dustini Spa Ronii]]|<ref name="MfMM">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>}}
The '''Golden Age''' for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] took place around [[25,053 BBY]] under the reign of the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt]] when Duro was a member of the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
